checks.rationale: Every in-scope action block is represented in order, with actual material boundaries through RNA recovery, a broad cDNA-library block, then sequence data and mapped arm pairs. Same-RNA and different-RNA icons depict alternative origins using the common route, not independently processed fractions. Capture support, mixed adaptor reagent, and reference data are legitimate additional inputs. The three multi-input operations are joint capture, joint adaptor addition, and joint data/reference mapping; none collapses independent processing. There is no invented pooling, isolated A/B fraction, waste route, or extra poster-method scope.

evidence.quote: (1) Cells are irradiated with UV-C light. (2) After lysis, the unprotected sections of RNAs are digested by RNase I, and the RBP is co-immunoprecipitated with the cross-linked RNA duplex.

(3) Two designated adaptors are ligated to both strands of the RNA duplex. Adaptor A (cloning adaptor) has a permanent 3′ block whilst adaptor B (linker adaptor) has a removable 3′ block. (4) 3′ block of adaptor B is removed. (5) The two strands of the RNA duplex are ligated via adaptor B.
(6) The RNA hybrid product is then converted into a cDNA library and sequenced as in iCLIP protocol19. The resulting data comprise hybrid and non-hybrid reads.
(7) Hybrid reads are selected and adaptors trimmed to define the sequences of left (L) and right (R) arms, which are mapped independently to the transcriptome.

card.description_verbatim:
hiCLIP sequences RNA duplexes bound to RBPs in vivo. The unique cloning and linker-adapter system in hiCLIP identifies whether the RBP-bound duplex originates from the same RNA or different RNAs.
Similar to CLIP library preparation techniques, RNA and RBPs are UV-crosslinked, partially digested, and immunoprecipitated. The signature hiCLIP cloning and linker-adapters are ligated to both strands of the duplex. The 3' end of the linker-adapter is dephosphorylated and ligated to the 5' end of the other strand. The bound proteins are removed with proteinase K. The cDNA library is prepared in a similar dashion to iCLIP for high-throughput sequencing. The cloning and linker-adapters enable the mapping of the hybrid reads to the transcriptome and distinguish whether the duplex is formed by the same RNAs or different RNAs.
advantages_verbatim: Maps RBP-bound RNA duplexes in vivo
Linker-adapter remediates physical and computational challenges seen in crosslinking, ligation, and sequencing of hybrids (CLASH)
limitations_verbatim: Does not identify non-RBP-bound RNA duplexes
Artifacts may be introduced in the circularization step
